svg.text: Proposed Azure deployment · Laravel application and existing self-hosted AI workflow retained
Logical service grouping; network/subnet design omitted
GPU-capable VM as needed · self-hosted services
Persistent ChromaDB data + agent SQLite checkpoints
Deploy stage pulls the selected image tag from Azure Container Registry onto each VM.
Solid arrows: application/data flow Dashed purple: CI/CD Dashed teal: secret access
Models and ChromaDB are custom software hosted on Azure, not managed Azure model/vector services. Model labels follow the supplied design.
